reconcile.note: Jamieson, Fausset & Brown read the prophets' refusals as God rejecting hypocritical, idol-tainted cries rather than the sincere calling Joel and Paul promise will save.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Steve Wells catalogues this as a contradiction, but the project's public-domain source survey found no verbatim critic passage that engages it.

sides.snippet: whoever will call on the name of Yahweh shall be saved
sides.verseText: It will happen that whoever will call on the name of Yahweh shall be saved; For in Mount Zion and in Jerusalem there will be those who escape, As Yahweh has said, And among the remnant, those whom Yahweh calls.

sides.snippet: Then they will cry to Yahweh, But he will not answer them.
sides.verseText: Then they will cry to Yahweh, But he will not answer them. Yes, he will hide his face from them at that time, Because they made their deeds evil.\"
